issues.description: Deprecation message duplicates info already in the docstring directive.
issues.detail: The runtime warning string and the .. deprecated:: 4.3 directive say the same thing twice. Not wrong, just slightly redundant. Fine to land; mention contextlib once and trust readers to find the docs.
The .. deprecated:: 4.3 block says 'Use the stlib's' — should be 'stdlib'. Trivial fixup before merge. Not a reason to bounce the patch, but fix it now so the rendered docs don't ship with a typo.

review.summary: One patch, one thing: slap a deprecation decorator on testing.redirected, migrate the one internal caller to contextlib, add a news fragment and a regression test for the warning. Diff is small, scoped, matches the existing deprecation pattern (same shape as the httpnow deprecation test right above it), commit message explains why. Good taste: deletes a special case in favor of the stdlib equivalent, exactly the kind of subtraction a maintainer should welcome. Two trivial nits — a typo ('stlib') and a mild message/docstring redundancy — neither blocks landing. Verdict: ACCEPT with trivial fixup.
